The Sandpapergate controversy of 2018 is back in the spotlight, and this time, former South African batting great AB de Villiers has made a fresh claim that could change the timeline of the infamous ball-tampering scandal.
De Villiers claims that the ball-tampering controversy involving Australia did not begin in the third Test at Cape Town, where Cameron Bancroft was caught using sandpaper. According to him, suspicious activity had already started during the first Test in Durban.
